summary: Canadian Pacific Kansas City Limited filed an 8-K reporting that its board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.268 per share on common shares, a 17.5% increase from the prior $0.228 per share. The dividend is payable on July 27, 2026, to holders of record on June 26, 2026. The increase reflects the company's commitment to returning cash to shareholders. There is no tender offer, acquisition, or strategic review involved; this is a routine capital return event. Watch for any future changes in dividend policy or capital allocation strategy.
